slides.title: Why pay for a guide when tips are free?
slides.body: Plenty of free tips are good. We post them every day.

slides.title: Tips are scattered
slides.body: Saved posts you can't find at 6am, in no particular order.

slides.title: The guide is one method
slides.body: Record, check, choose, set a boundary, follow through. In that order.

slides.title: It's printable
slides.body: A decision card and a 7-day practice sheet. No app, no subscription.

slides.title: A training plan or medical advice
slides.body: It helps you decide what fits today. That's it, and that's the point.
